{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = df.isnull().sum()

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = df.duplicated().sum()

# Check the distribution of the 'arm' column
arm_distribution = df['arm'].value_counts()

# Check the distribution of the 'responded' column
response_distribution = df['responded'].value_counts()

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_values = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0]

# Print results
print("Missing values:", missing_values.to_dict())
print("Duplicates:", duplicates)
print("Arm distribution:", arm_distribution.to_dict())
print("Response distribution:", response_distribution.to_dict())
print("Number of sentinel values (biomarker_baseline == -999.0):", len(sentinel_values))"}
